newsitem.title: NEPAL: Measles outbreak kills 85 children in Nepal.
newsitem.headline: Measles outbreak kills 85 children in Nepal.

text.p: An outbreak of measles in a remote district of western Nepal has killed 85 children over the past three months, the Health Ministry said on Sunday.
"This is a cumulative figure for three months in three villages," said Benu Bahadur Karki, director of the epidemiology and disease control division of the Ministry of Health.
"The outbreak is now on the decline."
Karki told Reuters that children were not regularly immunised in Dailekh district because few qualified doctors were willing to travel to the remote mountainous region.
The government has sent a team of doctors and health officers with medicines and vaccines to the area, he said.
This is the first major outbreak of measles in the Himalayan kingdom in recent years. Officials say water-borne diseases like gastroenteritis and cholera have killed 21 people this year.
